To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
class is a significant aspect of the lives and experiences of many counseling academics and that class influences the ways that these individuals experience and negotiate the academic environment.

counseling psychologists and counselor educators from lower- and lower-middle-class backgrounds described their experiences of hardship as a child, obstacles to advancement in their educational careers, resources that enabled their academic pursuits, and experiences of thwarted belonging needs within their referent group and academic settings.

how social class influences identity development and academic career development.

social class is an important aspect of diversity and multiculturalism, and that it is an aspect that is not adequately addressed in the current literature.
